input.encoding: [node count, root index, target value, then node triples [value, left child index, right child index]]. Child -1 means absent.
input.tree_requirement: A valid nonempty unique-value binary search tree; the root can be at any table index.
input.result: Index of the matching node, which identifies the root of the returned subtree; -1 if absent or the packed query header is invalid.
